note: Realization rules per role for evaluate_design.py search (geant4 program C1.2, section C.4.5): the parameters the search may change, their units, ranges and manufacturing tolerances, the parameters derived from them, the calibration template and the budget model of a subsystem the search adds. Generic, SYNTHETIC defaults: every budget input is an assumed model value, never an experiment's number; the budget rows a model writes are basis 'estimate' with a source that names the model. A new role or rule enters through a reviewed change of this file (a new rules_version); the file of an earlier version stays as roles-<version>.json, so a recorded search replays. 1.1.0: the tof and calorimetry-em rules name their geometry in the design-geometry mapping's parameters (contracts/rules/design_geometry.json 1.1.0), so a subsystem the search adds can be realized in Geant4; the F1 inputs path_m and the sampling structure are derived.

layer_x_over_x0.note: one value per plane: sensor_thickness / X0(sensor_material) from materials.json; support material belongs in passive_x_over_x0

calibration.method: track-based alignment of the planes (search template)

budget_model.name: planes-density-volume
budget_model.description: mass = N x plane_area x sensor thickness x density x (1 + support_mass_factor); channels = N x readout_sides x sqrt(plane_area) / strip_pitch; power and data rate per channel

field_T.note: uniform over the lever arm in the F1 tools; the magnet length is not a parameter (Example A's basis note: the planes outside the magnet see no field, which the F1 bound ignores)

calibration.method: field map with temperature monitoring (search template)

budget_model.name: magnet-placeholder
budget_model.description: declared placeholder, not a magnet design: mass = mass_per_tesla x field_T, power = power_per_tesla x field_T, no channels or data

layer_positions_m.note: plane centres along the stack axis (negative: upstream of the origin); the minimum spacing is at least the thickest layer, so planes do not overlap

path_m.note: flight path = last plane position - first plane position (the F1 time-of-flight input)

calibration.method: time-offset and time-walk calibration with tracks (search template)

budget_model.name: tof-planes
budget_model.description: mass = N x plane_area x layer_thickness x density(scintillator_material), N the number of layer_positions_m; channels = N x paddles_per_layer x 2 ends; power and data rate per channel

depth_x0.note: radiation lengths of the whole sampling structure, passive and active layers

sampling.note: template sampling structure of a search-derived calorimeter: the passive thickness is solved so that layers x (passive / X0(passive) + active / X0(active)) = depth_x0 (X0 from materials.json)

budget_model.name: calorimeter-block
budget_model.description: mass = block_area x sampling_layers x passive_thickness x density(passive_material) (absorber only); channels = block_area / cell_size^2; power and data rate per channel

calibration.method: ring-radius and photon-detector gain calibration (search template)

budget_model.name: rich-block
budget_model.description: declared model: mass = block_area x areal_mass; channels = block_area / pixel_size^2; power and data rate per channel
